# Diane Alcott — Program Officer, Hearthstone Foundation

- **Relationship:** external; the **Program Officer** who manages Keystone's grant relationship at
  the [Hearthstone Foundation](../projects/hearthstone-grant.md), historically the largest
  institutional funder.
- **Staff contact on our side:** [Daniela Cruz](daniela-cruz.md); Cam joins for the big moments.

## What she cares about
- Measurable outcomes (grade-level improvement, college enrollment) and clean, on-time reporting.
- **She delivered the news that the foundation declined the FY27 renewal** — a shift in Hearthstone's
  strategy toward early-childhood, not a reflection on Keystone's work. She remains warm and open to
  future, differently-scoped proposals.

## How to work with her
- Keep reporting immaculate — the overdue **Q2 grant report** matters to preserve the relationship.
- A future re-approach should fit Hearthstone's new early-childhood focus.
